summary: the subset cases against kernels that start a probe its option left out, ignore rach2.nousb, or leave the mouse out whatever the line says, and a bootlogprobe that reads none of the ring

argv: sh tests/proofs/guest.sh make rach2 tests && sh tests/proofs/guest.sh copy ${WORK} rach2/kernel tests/bootlogprobe
exec sh tests/proofs/guest.sh run subset 'run: subset: PASS'

faults.name: audio-started
faults.summary: a boot with rach2.noaudio says it left the audio probe out and then starts it all the same

lines: @etude 1 assert not-started fail the ring has the text

faults.name: nousb-ignored
faults.summary: the kernel starts the USB stack whatever the line says

faults.name: mouse-left-out
faults.summary: the kernel leaves the PS/2 mouse out on every boot, as if every line had rach2.nomouse

faults.name: ring-unread
faults.summary: bootlogprobe asks syslog(2) for none of the ring, so that every text is absent from what it read
